PHOTOVOLTAIC MODULE SUPPLY CHAIN TRACEABILITY STANDARDS AND TECHNOLOGY FOR REUSE AND RECYCLING
THE OBJECTIVE OF THIS PROJECT IS TO CREATE A SPECIFICATION, PROPOSED INDUSTRY STANDARD, AND TECHNOLOGY FOR SUPPLY CHAIN AND ASSET TRACEABILITY FOR PV SOLAR COMPONENTS TO ENABLE AND TRACK RECLAMATION, REUSE
